name: dragino-ps-lb
description: 4-20mA / 0-30V pressure & water-level sensor: battery, IDC loop current, VDC voltage, optional pulse count
caveats:
1) Probe_mod (bytes 2-3) omitted: the official decoder emits it as a 4-hex-digit STRING identifier (e.g. "0003"), not a measurement; a numeric u16 would differ from the official output.
2) Derived quantities Water_deep_cm / Water_pressure_kPa / Differential_pressure_Pa omitted: computed by transform() with conditionals on the probe-model bytes and per-range multipliers — not expressible in the fixed-table grammar. For the water-depth probe (model 0x00, range R metres): depth_cm = (idc_in - 4.0) * R * 100 / 16, computable downstream from the exposed idc_in.
3) Status byte (offset 8) omitted: pure bit flags (IN1/IN2/EXTI pin levels, EXTI trigger, IDC/VDC rate-of-change alarm flags) — bitmasks are not supported by the grammar.
4) pulses (u32@9) exists only in 13-byte counting-mode frames; on the normal 9-byte frame the grammar silently skips it (offset beyond frame), which exactly matches the official decoder's length==13 conditional. No HA unit assigned (it is a raw count).
5) Battery here is a full u16 with no status bits (unlike LHT65-family & 0x3FFF), so it is kept without a mask.
6) Table applies to FPort 2 (official decoder's default case) only; FPort 3/5/7/8 (datalog, device status, multi-TDC) frames have different layouts and must not be fed to this codec.
7) No sentinel values are documented for IDC/VDC in the manual; idc_in <= 4.0 mA simply means "below range start" (official transform clamps derived depth to 0 there).
8) Test vectors are constructed (Dragino publishes no full FPort-2 frame); vector 1's bat/IDC/VDC bytes are the exact field-level examples from the official wiki manual, and both vectors were verified against tools/validate.py (passes) and hand-traced through the official decoder.
